Dense fitted sections — BLAZING deep sea-blue amber surface with a golden glow across the full torso both legs neck to ankle, VIVID pale cyan swirls and tiny bubbles flowing through every section, with thin brass inlay lines running along the grain of every section, high-gloss polished, completely opaque, NO airbrush NO gradient wash, NO flat printed surface anywhere. Jewelry: heavy gold rings on every finger, a wide gold waist chain resting over the carved curve of her hips, and a gold belly chain with a small pendant at her navel. Jewelry is metal and pearl only, worn on the body, nothing added to her face or ears.

Background: the ancient Parthenon terrace on the Acropolis in Athens, pale weathered marble paving, fluted columns and standard-height stone steps, empty of tourists, under a soft overcast sky with gentle diffused light, bright and evenly lit, shadows soft, the whole floor and surroundings clearly visible and in focus, NO dark background NO black void, completely empty of other people, no readable signs or text anywhere, no props or statues made of the same material as her. ONE woman only. Extreme macro detail on every surface texture and shadow. Pattern density MAXIMUM — zero bare skin anywhere from neck to ankle. Full-length wide shot from a moderate distance with the camera at waist height, the whole figure from the soles of the boots to the top of her head completely visible, with the door, railing or steps beside her at normal human scale so the extreme heel height reads at a glance, the towering heels clearly separating the boot soles from the floor. 8K portrait 2:3 aspect ratio.
